analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but not yet a confirmed trend reversal. ADX at 39.9 indicates strong trend but -DI (30.9) is above +DI (19.0), suggesting stronger downward pressure. Volume at 0.25x the 5-day average is subdued, lowering confidence in directional conviction. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
